PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: Link your welder, grinder and drill to an owned or faction-shared inventory.
PluginData.Description:
Connect tools to an owned or faction-shared inventory. Ownership rules apply to the selected port. Welders use vanilla conveyor access, including docked grids and unowned or Share All sources when normal permissions allow. Grinders and drills deposit into the target.
Transfers work inside grid bounds, pause outside, and break more than 100 m beyond them. Overlapping enemy grids block tethering.
Ship damage, weapon fire and supported EMP/jump inhibition trigger a two-minute cooldown across mechanical and docked grids. Player bump damage and own grinding do not count. Isolated connector hits are tolerated; repeated damage or destruction still counts. New grids and WeaponCore weapons need observation. Cooldowns survive reconnects.
No server mod required. Supports vanilla weapons and optional WeaponCore/Vanilla+.
/tether - connect /tether off - disconnect /tether bounds - toggle bounds /tether bounds off - hide bounds
